reason: I already scroll sleep and magnesium videos at night, and the named lab report plus the money-back if I finish the box takes most of the risk away. At $24.99 I'd try one box, not two.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference? Magnesium is subtle, and Made in China still makes me a little nervous even with the US lab test.
would_change_my_mind: A creator I follow showing the lab report and saying she slept better after a couple of weeks would push me to the two-box deal. If the price were over $35 or the report wasn't really there, I'd pass.
